Name: Elliott Scottish Wedding Kilt
Author: Elaho
TagLine:
Replaces Elliott's vanilla wedding outfit with a traditional Scottish wedding kilt. 
Now with seasonal variations!
Description:
***_UPDATE:_** January 28 2022: This mod is now compatible with the Diverse Stardew Valley mod (including all seasonal variations!) Check it out [here](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/modpacks/8013-diverse-stardew-valley).

This mod replaces Elliott's original wedding outfit with a traditional Scottish wedding kilt (tartan), based on the Formal Prince Charlie fashion, and includes:

- Prince Charlie jacket and waistcoat
- Collared shirt, jabot, and pin
- Dress sporran and sporran strap (frontal pouch),
- Sgian-dubh (small knife kept in the sock)
- Kilt hose and flashes (socks and sock tassels)
- Kilt (+ pin),
- Brogues (lace-up shoes), and
- Fly plaid (a long strip of plaid matching the kilt pattern, worn over the shoulder and fastened with a brooch).

Elliott is a really interesting character and I wanted to give his cultural background a little more depth.
The Scots are known for being a rugged, robust people, and thinking about Elliott's love of historical dress, interest in classical works of art, rugged features, and long red hair, I thought making his family/ancestry Scottish would suit him really well.

The clan Lockhart was chosen for Elliott because of its romantic-sounding name, and because its (modern) tartan weave features red and green, colours Elliott wears in his vanilla sprite design. Donning the Lockhart colours, marrying Elliott also means your farmer becomes part of the Lockhart clan as well.
__Meal an naidheachd air pòsadh! :)__

-----------------------------
*PLEASE NOTE:

**UPDATE:** V.1.1.3 [or higher] is now compatible with Poltergeister's Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod. No action needed.

This mod will NOT work with other wedding outfit mods that include Elliott. If you want this mod to be compatible with other sprite editing mods, you'll need to either delete Elliott's wedding version in those mods or only have this one installed. Having two different mods that change Elliott's wedding appearance will not work together and may cause the game to crash.*
